pages.name: done
pages.text_excerpt: Capture Desktop is installed Remove the installation media and restart the computer. The new system has not started yet, so nothing has checked it. At its first start, it records which image it started, in /var/lib/fisherman/boot-receipt/.

notes: GPU-less capture: pages are driven programmatically and text is read from the widget tree, so this reports SCREEN PARITY only. It does not measure keyboard navigation, compositor rendering, or that the frontend launches under its real desktop — those stay the VM walkthrough's job.
